parents.course: Advanced Topics in Data Analytics & Data Science

ns2:section.sectionText: This class will provide an overview of the history and commonly offered command line interfaces and essential shell scripting tools. These approaches will be extended to cover common version control tools, including git and GitHub, their value, and how to appropriately organize a project within them. Pre- and Co-requisites: Some programming experience is required, either demonstrated via previous experience or having completed IS 430-Foundations of Information Processing (formerly known as IS 452-Foundations of Information Processing). Concurrent enrollment within IS 430-Foundations of Information Processing (formerly known as IS 452-Foundations of Information Processing) may be acceptable with instructor approval. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences or Illinois Informatics Institute department.
